description: This file defines exception handler functions for a FastAPI-based web application, managing various error types and converting them into appropriate HTTP responses.

classes.name: ExceptionHandlers
classes.description: A class containing static methods for handling various exceptions and converting them into HTTP responses.

methods.name: _handle
methods.description: Internal method to handle exceptions, logging error and returning JSONResponse with status and detail.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Handles general exceptions, differentiating between ValueError, missing parameters, and other errors, returning appropriate HTTP responses.

methods.name: validation
methods.description: Handles validation errors, including those from QueryParams, and returns detailed error responses.

methods.name: openbb
methods.description: Handles OpenBBError exceptions, returning a 400 response with the error's original message.

methods.name: empty_data
methods.description: Handles EmptyDataError exceptions, returning a 204 No Content response.

methods.name: unauthorized
methods.description: Handles UnauthorizedError exceptions, returning a 502 response with the error's original message.
